searches.reason: Separate reliance on recent evidence from sensitivity to sequence positions and the final readout item. Seek paired probes on each category’s single trained HSTU that preserve the final observed item, compare deletion with position-preserving interventions where supported, and use matched random perturbations as controls. This should identify which internal mechanisms warrant inspection without interpreting ranking changes as causal evidence of intent.

searches.reason: Translate qualitative complaints about broad relevance, speculative compatibility, duplicates, and stale interests into evidence-grounded diagnostics. Seek interpretable relations extracted only from available titles, descriptions, histories, and timestamps, with explicit unknown labels when evidence is insufficient. Validate these proxies against available user feedback before treating them as measures of purchase intent; require neither pretrained weights nor unavailable metadata.
searches.query: recommendation diagnostics task relevance versus thematic similarity product compatibility duplicate recommendation evidence grounding abstention title description lexical relations user feedback validation 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Establish whether diagnostic signals reliably identify ranking failures and suggest useful training changes. Seek paired uncertainty estimates, popularity-matched negative controls, candidate-set sensitivity analysis, and prefix-based temporal stress tests using training histories only. Keep these auxiliary probes separate from the unchanged host validation HR@10, account for four-category differences, and prioritize inexpensive checks within the search budget.
